_doc: Scroll families of the Warrior line: the one-handed sword, axe and blunt weapon slots (2043xxx), the two-handed sword, axe and blunt weapon, spear and polearm slots (2044xxx) and the shield slot (2040900-2040933). Each weapon slot has the two v83 families a Warrior wants, ATT and ACC (accuracy); the shield slot DEF, STR, HP, LUK and ATT (v83 has no 100% shield ATT scroll). Slots are named by the item kind (the scroll category, Scrolls.category_of_scroll, is what ties a scroll to an item); the weapon kinds are the weapon_slots of ../shops/warrior.json (priced as weapons), the shield is priced as armour. Rate keys and tier rules: see ../scrolls.json _doc. Out, as there: the 65%/15%, 50% and anniversary event series, the strong 100% scrolls, King Pepe's 60% scrolls, the 2/3 DEF 100% shield scroll and the Magic Att. weapon and shield scrolls (Magician gear). tier C: our selection; ids, stats and rates are v83 Item.wz/Consume/0204.img.
